name: PLA (Polylactic Acid)
description: The most widely used 3D printing filament. Plant-based, odorless, easy to print with minimal warping, perfect for prototypes, decorative models, and consumer prints.

name: PLA+ / Tough PLA
description: Impact-modified PLA formulated with elastomeric additives for improved layer bonding, higher fracture toughness, and reduced brittleness.

name: Silk PLA (Glossy Metallic)
description: Blended with thermoplastic elastomers or polyester to create a satin sheen. Beautiful for display items, vases, and sculptures; slightly lower inter-layer adhesion.

name: Matte PLA
description: Filled with mineral powders or chalk to scatter light and disguise layer lines. Creates a clean injection-molded look, slightly heavier density per cubic centimeter.

name: PETG (Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol)
description: Combines the ease of PLA with higher chemical resistance, weather durability, and ductility. Ideal for functional brackets, outdoor tools, and watertight containers.

name: ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene)
description: Lightweight and heat-resistant engineering thermoplastic. Can be acetone vapor smoothed. Requires an enclosed chamber to avoid warping and splits.

name: ASA (Acrylonitrile Styrene Acrylate)
description: UV-resistant variant of ABS with outstanding weatherability for outdoor automotive and marine applications. Resists color fading and UV embrittlement.

name: TPU 95A (Flexible Polyurethane)
description: Rubber-like flexibility with Shore 95A hardness. Extreme tear and abrasion resistance; used for gaskets, phone cases, vibration dampeners, and drone bumpers.

name: PA6-CF (Carbon Fiber Nylon)
description: High-stiffness engineering composite reinforced with chopped carbon fibers. Exceptional tensile strength and thermal tolerance up to 185°C. Requires hardened nozzle.

name: PC (Polycarbonate)
description: Ultra-tough, optical clarity capable, high-temperature industrial polymer. High impact resistance, used for protective shields, automotive brackets, and drone frames.

name: Wood Composite PLA
description: Filled with 15–20% recycled wood fibers. Can be sanded, stained, and smells like real timber when extruded. Needs 0.5mm+ nozzle to prevent clogging.

name: Standard Photopolymer Resin (405nm)
description: Fast-curing UV photopolymer resin for MSLA/SLA printers. Delivers microscopic resolution for miniatures, jewelry masters, and dental study models.

name: ABS-Like Tough Resin
description: High-impact resin with balanced flexural modulus, preventing the typical brittleness of standard resin. Excellent for snap-fit functional enclosures.

name: Plant-Based Eco UV Resin
description: Synthesized with soybean oil derivatives for lower odor and reduced VOC emissions during indoor residential printing.
